notes: Comma, right-associative assignment, conditional expressions, and DisallowIn boundaries preserve token nodes and exact ranges.
All binary and assignment spellings use scanner SyntaxKinds; precedence, exponentiation associativity, as, satisfies, and greater-token rescans are reference-checked.
Prefix, postfix, keyword unary, await, yield, yield-star, assertion, and exponentiation-left diagnostics match parser behavior and ranges.
Simple, parenthesized, async, generic, typed, concise, and block arrows share upstream speculation boundaries; failed non-JSX candidates are cached by source position.
Property, element, private-name, non-null, and optional-chain forms preserve question-dot tokens, propagated OptionalChain flags, recovery, and diagnostics.
Calls, optional calls, instantiation expressions, generic tagged templates, argument lists, and type-argument/template rescans retain list metadata and ambiguity behavior.
Non-JSX primary expressions cover tokens, literals, regexp rescans, parentheses, templates, arrays, spread, elisions, and exact NodeArray ranges.
Properties, shorthand defaults, spread, computed names, methods, accessors, generators, async modifiers, and function bodies preserve fields and recovery.

Function expressions and the class-expression primary boundary are connected; new, new.target, import calls, import.meta, import.defer, and source flags are covered. Full class members are covered by the statement/declaration parser.
